Name: RSI handles flat prices correctly
Description:
Verifies RSI behavior when prices don't move (flat market).
    
    Expected behavior:
    - RSI should return 50 (neutral) for flat prices
    - This indicates no momentum in either direction
    
    Why this matters:
    - Flat prices mean no gains or losses
    - RSI should reflect neutral market condition
    - Prevents false signals in sideways markets

Name: RSI returns values between 0 and 100
Description:
Verifies that RSI calculation always produces values within the valid range of 0-100.
    
    This is critical because:
    - RSI values outside this range indicate calculation errors
    - Trading decisions depend on accurate RSI values
    - Invalid RSI could lead to incorrect signals
    
    Test validates:
    - All RSI values are >= 0
    - All RSI values are <= 100
    - No NaN values in output (after initial period)
